Party B gets the 4 ridings it earned, plus 2 more, for a total of 6 seats. Party C gets 0 seats from won Ridings, but 1 seat for its 5% of the vote share. This is the system New Zealand uses, and it does a good job of shutting down gerrymandering, among other things.
